rationale: The definition includes fish and shellfish; 見合わせる conveys temporary postponement or refraining.
Remove 境涯 from close-similar words; it belongs to life-circumstances vocabulary, not a close synonym of inner state.
杉 is Japanese cryptomeria/Japanese cedar, not a generic cedar.
Avoid absolute “strongest”; render the university as a strong athletics team.
Correct Japanese case/attachment with 事件について.
Naturalize 得意な教科を伸ばす as developing strengths in school subjects.
Preserve the meaning of sharing lessons throughout the organization.
